subject: IT support handoff
body:
2026-10-26T17:25:00+01:00 — Lena Fischer: Priya, Thomas wants the queue summary for review. I can describe the cable problem, but screen issue turned out to mean two requests. Anton requested a display cable; the other screenshot concerns a classroom connection. I almost combined the wrong examples.
2026-10-26T17:25:58+01:00 — Priya Nair: Give each its actual equipment name. Don't attach all the screenshots and expect the review to become a guessing competition.
2026-10-26T17:27:05+01:00 — Lena Fischer: The tablet shortcut is still open, right? Rosa said the new link worked while the old square kept loading the wrong rota. I don't want the review to assume that open means nobody has looked at it. Sometimes the tested fix solved a different problem.
2026-10-26T17:28:23+01:00 — Priya Nair: Exactly. Testing the replacement link didn't fix the saved shortcut. That distinction needs to survive the handoff.
2026-10-26T17:29:46+01:00 — Lena Fischer: Theo also marked a duplicate invoice. I've kept the note that it is one document exported twice, not two support visits. Ines can see why the number changed. Otherwise somebody will discover a gap and ask whether we hid an invoice.
2026-10-26T17:30:50+01:00 — Priya Nair: Good. Leave the marked copy for Finance. A tidy folder isn't useful if we erase the explanation of a duplicate.
